name: edgegrasp_so101_candidate020_reachable_preclose

changed_variable.name: reachable_preclose_grasp_pose
changed_variable.baseline: Candidate019 exact-clearance pose was not reachable at its retained five-axis orientation
changed_variable.candidate: closest collision-valid FK sample from a bounded local pan/lift/elbow/wrist scan
changed_variable.purpose: preserve a contact-free pre-close gap without leaving the SO-101 five-axis reachable manifold

claim_boundary: Candidate020 changes the grasp orientation and local target placement to one geometry-gated FK sample, then uses one accepted OMPL route state as a deterministic Pilz waypoint.
The 3.923 mm FK target-point error, 5.803 mm descend palm clearance, 51.853 mm approach clearance, and primitive-pad margins are static evidence only.
Approach, descend, and lift must all pass repeated MoveIt plan-only checks before any execution is considered.
Planning success does not prove zero runtime pre-close contact, bilateral grasp, lift, retention, or hardware behavior.
